descriptions.text: PVP Coupon. Ah, betrayal. Sweet, delicious betrayal. If you have this coupon in your inventory, and you kill the crawler whose name appears on the backside of this coupon, you will receive the following rewards: Gold Savage Box Gold Weapons Box Gold Apparel Box Platinum Adventurer Box (This benefit may only be redeemed a max of 3 times) +1 Player Level (This benefit may only be redeemed a max of 3 times)

recap.text: Katia hands Carl a black PVP coupon with a gold-leaf skull, marked Crawler #4,122, the only one she saw Donut stuff under the track. Imani's Savage box held only coupons, one per party member, and they would not burn, so she left them on the first floor. In the rental trailer, Donut speaks first: she buried Carl's under a train track and threw Katia's in the garbage at Hotdog on a Stick. Carl relaxes.

beats.headline: Sweet, delicious betrayal
beats.text: Katia hands Carl a slip of paper. While he was gone after the Nightmare hit him, she and Donut went back out to clean the tracks, and practising with her third eye she saw Donut pull this from her inventory and stuff it under the track. She grew a new arm along the rail and grabbed it. It is a black ticket with a gold-leaf skull, and its description is a list of boxes and a player level. On the back: Crawler #4,122. Carl. Hekla says, Katia explains, that a party crawler who earns a skull gets one for every member. This is the only one Donut got rid of.
beats.gist: Katia gives Carl a black PVP coupon Donut hid under the track, the only one Donut discarded.

beats.headline: Imani's book
beats.text: Katia fears Donut still has one with her name on it. Her friend Eva has a skull, she says, for a man she stabbed in the back of the leg, and the coupon book, and told only Hekla. Carl pockets the coupon and asks Imani. She got a Savage box holding only the coupon book, one coupon for every member of the party. She tried to burn them and they would not catch fire, so she left them on the first floor, though Brandon wanted her to keep them. Elle got none with her skull. Donut told Imani about the two she received, and Imani told her to get rid of them.
beats.gist: Imani could not burn her coupons, left them, and told Donut to discard hers.

beats.headline: Buried and binned
beats.text: In the rental trailer, before they leave, Carl starts to raise something, and Donut gets there first: is it about the PVP coupons? Imani is a big gossip, she says, and messaged to apologise. You don't need to worry, Carl. She got rid of them. She did not like having them, so she buried his under a train track and threw Katia's out in the garbage at that Hotdog on a Stick place, and quite frankly it is a subject she would rather not talk about. Carl relaxes. That went much easier than he thought it would.
beats.gist: Imani buried Carl's PVP coupons under a train track and binned Katia's.
